content: The function EthSwt_GetPortIdentifier shall return the value of the organizationally unique identifier (OUI 24 bit) of the indexed Ethernet switch port that is connected to the indexed Ethernet switch. It shall set the 8 most significant bits of the OUI to 0xFFxxxxxx. If the Ethernet switch port references an Ethernet transceiver, the function shall obtain the OUI by calling the function EthTrcv_Get- PhyIdentifier and set the 8 most significant bits of the OUI to 0x00xxxxxx.
